sources.finding: Markdown notes with blocks, backlinks, @ file mentions, icons/covers/properties; graph view; import folders (e.g. Obsidian vaults). Attach via @ in composer as visible context block; memory-searchable by agents.

sources.title: Sessions Atlas
sources.locator: Start or resume; Find your sessions; Settle; Bring in sessions sections
sources.finding: One agent per session; transcript incl. file reads/commands/edits; second session beside it (Cmd-T A); reopen repaints transcript from disk while agent reconnects. Sidebar lists sessions across org projects with project/branch/status, search, pins, snooze/settle (auto-settle idle 3 days, never running/waiting), per-branch worktree starts with checkout-lock checks. Import sessions agents kept on their own (incl. terminal).

sources.title: Settings Atlas
sources.locator: Preferences/Library groups; Per-project settings; Privacy row sections
sources.finding: Preferences in ~/.config/atlas/config.toml (commented, hand-editable, invalid edits keep last-good with error shown). Per-project: default agent, Atlas Agent permissions, code search, auto-fetch, git blame, memory jobs (off-for-all stays off). Privacy page: "Share usage data" toggle. Library: Agents (env vars incl. keychain-marked secrets, models incl. custom model by name, provider keys), Skills, Layouts.

sources.title: Configuration file Atlas
sources.locator: keys table incl. Notifications, confirmDeleteChat, keepAwakeWhileRunning sections
sources.finding: Every config.toml key documented: auto-add .atlas to .gitignore, keepAwakeWhileRunning (prevent idle sleep while an agent works; macOS/Linux), confirm-before-delete/quit guards, per-kind notification switches (native banners + sounds; terminal command thresholds; rate-limit/retry warnings), model pricing source models.dev.

sources.title: Power user Atlas
sources.locator: Shortcuts; Command palette sections
sources.finding: Default shortcuts incl. Cmd-K palette, Cmd-T surfaces, Cmd-Shift-B source control, Cmd-J terminal, Alt-/ agent cycle, Shift-Tab mode cycle; keymap presets VS Code/Cursor/Zed/JetBrains with import/export; layouts; hint navigation. Recent Sessions shows per-session project, local-vs-worktree, agent, recency.

sources.title: Terminal Atlas
sources.locator: Split work; Get notified when a command finishes sections
sources.finding: Own shell tabs beside sessions, splits, link finding, zsh integration; finish notifications (failures/input always; success past threshold; 10s default).

sources.title: Team overview Atlas
sources.locator: How the pieces fit sections
sources.finding: Multiplayer defined as shared record: timeline of every recorded session with prompts/tool calls/commits, comments beside the work, team chat/calls/drafts/Spaces/shared threads; organization owns sharing; cloud projects merge teammates' sessions; source code never syncs.

sources.title: Your account Atlas
sources.locator: What signing in unlocks; Google/GitHub providers; Manage your devices; Access token sections
sources.finding: Editor/terminal/git/ACP agents/memory/local capture/personal timeline work signed out in a local org. Sign-in unlocks synced org, Atlas Agent (+AI access), cloud projects, chat/calls/drafts/Spaces, web app. Google or GitHub sign-in (connectable both), device-code flow, per-device Active sessions with remote sign-out. Access token section: short-lived personal token for scripts.

sources.title: Ask Atlas Atlas
sources.locator: Turn it on; daily allowance; Deep research/Facts/Loops sections
sources.finding: Organization's own agent on Atlas servers (no repo access): answers from recorded sessions/projects/comments/chat with links; drafts actions for approval; runs Deep research, Facts, Loops. Admin-enabled per org; billed to org AI budget with per-person daily question counts (e.g. "12 of 200 today"). Private per-person sessions; What-it-remembers deletable.

sources.title: Beta program Atlas
sources.locator: Who it is for; atlas-beta organization sections
sources.finding: Beta run inside Atlas itself (atlas-beta org team chat/calls/drafts); public Discord open; contributors path via Contributing.

sources.title: Testing Atlas
sources.locator: Report-a-bug template; Export vs Share guidance sections
sources.finding: Bug reports need Atlas version/OS, agent/model, session (exported file or share link) and logs; cloud sessions shareable with Anyone public links (password, stop sharing); session may contain file contents/command output with secrets redacted pre-storage.

sources.title: Feedback Atlas
sources.locator: Send feedback in Atlas; GitHub issues sections
sources.finding: In-app feedback (Issue/Feature/Improve/Other) with screenshot attach, sent even with usage data off; anonymous option; public Discord and GitHub Bug Report / Feature Request forms.

sources.title: Joining the beta Atlas
sources.locator: Sign up; Accept the invitation sections
sources.finding: Join flow: install, create account, request at credits.tryatlas.cc (beta tester option), accept atlas-beta invite. "Atlas team reviews every sign-up"; shared cloud sessions visible to all members — keep private code in own org.

sources.title: Concepts Atlas
sources.locator: Project, Workspace, Session, Turn, Session capture, Checkpoint, Timeline, Comment definitions
sources.finding: Canonical definitions: project (.atlas/ dir, gitignored); workspace (org's shared record copy); session (one agent conversation, resumable); checkpoint (session↔commit link, survives amends/rebases, orphans on ambiguity); timeline; comment threads. Desktop finds checkpoints by watching refs without git hooks; CLI uses post-commit hook.
